title: "Module 06: Spatial transcriptomics assembly and quality control"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-11"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 06 — Spatial transcriptomics assembly and quality control
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Load four 10x Genomics Visium datasets, preserve spatial images and
#   coordinates, merge the slides, calculate spot-level QC metrics, inspect
#   sequencing quality across tissue sections, apply QC thresholds, and save
#   the filtered spatial Seurat object for downstream analysis.
#
# Input:
#   data/raw/spatial_raw/
#
# Output:
#   data/processed/spatial/spatial_QC_filtered_seurat.rds
#   results/spatial/qc/
#   figures/spatial/qc/
#
# QC thresholds:
#   nFeature_Spatial >= 200
#   percent.mt <= 25
#
# Notes:
#   Raw counts are retained. Normalization, dimensionality reduction,
#   integration, and clustering are performed in Module 07.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(hdf5r)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis parameters

spatial_assay <- "Spatial"

minimum_features <- 200
maximum_percent_mt <- 25


# Repository paths

spatial_raw_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "raw",
  "spatial_raw"
)

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "qc"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "qc"
)


for (directory in c(
  processed_directory,
  results_directory,
  figure_directory
)) {

  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


qc_filtered_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_QC_filtered_seurat.rds"
)


# Sample metadata

sample_info <- data.frame(

  sample = c(
    "Normal_Tissue",
    "Niacin_Treatment",
    "Vehicle_1",
    "Vehicle_2"
  ),

  condition = c(
    "Normal",
    "Niacin",
    "Vehicle",
    "Vehicle"
  ),

  slide_directory = c(
    "Naive-A9",
    "Niacin2-B5",
    "Vehicle1-C5",
    "Vehicle2-D5"
  ),

  count_file = c(
    "naive_A9_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
    "Niacin2_B5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
    "vehicle1_c5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
    "vehicle2_D5_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
  ),

  image_name = c(
    "Naive_A9",
    "Niacin2_B5",
    "Vehicle1_C5",
    "Vehicle2_D5"
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


print(sample_info)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load spatial datasets
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!dir.exists(spatial_raw_directory)) {
  stop(
    "Spatial raw-data directory not found: ",
    spatial_raw_directory
  )
}


load_spatial_sample <- function(sample_row) {

  sample_directory <- file.path(
    spatial_raw_directory,
    sample_row$slide_directory
  )

  count_file <- file.path(
    sample_directory,
    sample_row$count_file
  )


  if (!dir.exists(sample_directory)) {
    stop(
      "Spatial sample directory not found: ",
      sample_directory
    )
  }


  if (!file.exists(count_file)) {
    stop(
      "Spatial count matrix not found: ",
      count_file
    )
  }


  message(
    "Loading spatial sample: ",
    sample_row$sample
  )


  spatial_object <- Seurat::Load10X_Spatial(
    data.dir = sample_directory,
    filename = sample_row$count_file,
    assay = spatial_assay,
    slice = sample_row$image_name,
    filter.matrix = TRUE,
    image.name = "tissue_lowres_image.png"
  )


  spatial_object$sample <- sample_row$sample
  spatial_object$condition <- sample_row$condition
  spatial_object$slide <- sample_row$image_name


  return(spatial_object)
}


spatial_objects <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(sample_info)),
  function(i) {

    load_spatial_sample(
      sample_info[i, ]
    )
  }
)


names(spatial_objects) <- sample_info$sample


# Summarize loaded datasets.

individual_object_summary <- data.frame(

  sample = names(spatial_objects),

  condition = vapply(
    spatial_objects,
    function(x) unique(as.character(x$condition))[1],
    character(1)
  ),

  features = vapply(
    spatial_objects,
    nrow,
    numeric(1)
  ),

  spots = vapply(
    spatial_objects,
    ncol,
    numeric(1)
  ),

  image = vapply(
    spatial_objects,
    function(x) paste(Seurat::Images(x), collapse = ";"),
    character(1)
  )
)


print(individual_object_summary)


write.csv(
  individual_object_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_individual_object_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Inspect tissue sections and merge slides
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Visualize the spatial coverage of each tissue section before merging.

tissue_plots <- lapply(
  seq_along(spatial_objects),
  function(i) {

    Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
      spatial_objects[[i]]
    ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = sample_info$sample[i]
      )
  }
)


raw_tissue_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  tissue_plots,
  nrow = 1
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_raw_tissue_sections.png"
  ),
  plot = raw_tissue_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


# Merge all four slides.

spatial_merge <- merge(
  x = spatial_objects[[1]],
  y = spatial_objects[-1],
  add.cell.ids = c(
    "normal",
    "niacin",
    "vehicle1",
    "vehicle2"
  ),
  project = "GBM_spatial"
)


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_merge
) <- spatial_assay


message(
  "Merged spatial object: ",
  nrow(spatial_merge),
  " features and ",
  ncol(spatial_merge),
  " spots."
)


print(
  table(spatial_merge$sample)
)


# Join Seurat v5 assay layers after merging.

if (
  length(
    SeuratObject::Layers(
      spatial_merge[[spatial_assay]]
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  spatial_merge <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_merge,
    assay = spatial_assay
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Calculate spatial QC metrics
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_merge[["percent.mt"]] <- Seurat::PercentageFeatureSet(
  spatial_merge,
  assay = spatial_assay,
  pattern = "^mt-"
)


mitochondrial_genes <- grep(
  "^mt-",
  rownames(spatial_merge),
  value = TRUE
)


if (length(mitochondrial_genes) == 0) {

  warning(
    "No mitochondrial genes matched '^mt-'. ",
    "Confirm the mouse gene-symbol naming convention."
  )
}


required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "slide",
  "nCount_Spatial",
  "nFeature_Spatial",
  "percent.mt"
)


missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_merge@meta.data)
)


if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Required spatial QC metadata missing: ",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


# Summarize QC before filtering.

spatial_qc_summary_before <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    total_spots = dplyr::n(),

    median_counts = median(
      nCount_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_features = median(
      nFeature_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_percent_mt = median(
      percent.mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(spatial_qc_summary_before)


write.csv(
  spatial_qc_summary_before,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_QC_summary_before_filtering.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Assess spatial QC
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Examine candidate thresholds before applying the final QC criteria.

spatial_qc_thresholds <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    total_spots = dplyr::n(),

    percent_below_200_features =
      mean(nFeature_Spatial < 200, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    percent_below_300_features =
      mean(nFeature_Spatial < 300, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    percent_mt_above_10 =
      mean(percent.mt > 10, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    percent_mt_above_15 =
      mean(percent.mt > 15, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    percent_mt_above_20 =
      mean(percent.mt > 20, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    percent_mt_above_25 =
      mean(percent.mt > 25, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(spatial_qc_thresholds)


write.csv(
  spatial_qc_thresholds,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_QC_threshold_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# QC distributions across samples.

qc_violin_plot <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
  spatial_merge,
  features = c(
    "nFeature_Spatial",
    "nCount_Spatial",
    "percent.mt"
  ),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0.1
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_QC_violin_plots_before_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = qc_violin_plot,
  width = 15,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


# Plot each QC metric across the tissue sections.

plot_spatial_qc_metric <- function(
    feature,
    filename
) {

  plots <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(sample_info)),
    function(i) {

      Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
        spatial_merge,
        features = feature,
        images = sample_info$image_name[i]
      ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = sample_info$sample[i]
        )
    }
  )


  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    plots,
    nrow = 1
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      figure_directory,
      filename
    ),
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = 18,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


plot_spatial_qc_metric(
  feature = "nCount_Spatial",
  filename = "spatial_nCount_QC.png"
)


plot_spatial_qc_metric(
  feature = "nFeature_Spatial",
  filename = "spatial_nFeature_QC.png"
)


plot_spatial_qc_metric(
  feature = "percent.mt",
  filename = "spatial_percent_mt_QC.png"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Apply spatial QC filters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Estimate retention before filtering.

spatial_retention_expected <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    spots_before = dplyr::n(),

    spots_retained = sum(
      nFeature_Spatial >= minimum_features &
        percent.mt <= maximum_percent_mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    spots_removed =
      spots_before -
      spots_retained,

    percent_retained =
      100 *
      spots_retained /
      spots_before
  )


print(spatial_retention_expected)


# Apply selected thresholds.

spatial_qc <- subset(
  spatial_merge,
  subset =
    nFeature_Spatial >= minimum_features &
    percent.mt <= maximum_percent_mt
)


if (ncol(spatial_qc) == 0) {
  stop(
    "Spatial QC filtering removed all spots."
  )
}


# Confirm that every sample remains represented.

samples_after_qc <- unique(
  as.character(
    spatial_qc$sample
  )
)


missing_samples <- setdiff(
  sample_info$sample,
  samples_after_qc
)


if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Sample(s) lost during QC filtering: ",
    paste(
      missing_samples,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Summarize post-QC dataset
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_qc_summary_after <- spatial_qc@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    sample,
    condition
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    total_spots = dplyr::n(),

    median_counts = median(
      nCount_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_features = median(
      nFeature_Spatial,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    median_percent_mt = median(
      percent.mt,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


write.csv(
  spatial_qc_summary_after,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_QC_summary_after_filtering.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Final spot-retention table.

spots_before_by_sample <- spatial_merge@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "spots_before"
  )


spots_after_by_sample <- spatial_qc@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "spots_after"
  )


filtering_summary <- spots_before_by_sample %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    spots_after_by_sample,
    by = c(
      "sample",
      "condition"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    spots_after = tidyr::replace_na(
      spots_after,
      0
    ),

    spots_removed =
      spots_before -
      spots_after,

    percent_retained =
      100 *
      spots_after /
      spots_before
  )


print(filtering_summary)


write.csv(
  filtering_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_QC_filtering_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# QC distributions after filtering.

qc_violin_after_plot <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
  spatial_qc,
  features = c(
    "nFeature_Spatial",
    "nCount_Spatial",
    "percent.mt"
  ),
  group.by = "sample",
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0.1
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_QC_violin_plots_after_filtering.png"
  ),
  plot = qc_violin_after_plot,
  width = 15,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save QC-filtered spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  spatial_qc,
  qc_filtered_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


message(
  "Module 06 complete: ",
  ncol(spatial_merge),
  " spots before QC; ",
  ncol(spatial_qc),
  " spots after QC; ",
  round(
    100 * ncol(spatial_qc) / ncol(spatial_merge),
    1
  ),
  "% retained."
)
```
